WITH project_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    s.arcref,
    p.fundflux,
    SUM(s.gbsize) / SUM(s.spanmin) as rate
  FROM scans s
  JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
  WHERE s.gbsize IS NOT NULL 
    AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL 
    AND s.spanmin > 0
  GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) as avg_rate
  FROM project_rates
),
with_gap AS (
  SELECT 
    pr.arcref,
    pr.fundflux,
    pr.rate,
    pr.rate - b.avg_rate as gap
  FROM project_rates pr
  CROSS JOIN benchmark b
  WHERE pr.rate > b.avg_rate
)
SELECT 
  arcref,
  fundflux,
  rate,
  gap
FROM with_gap
ORDER BY gap DESC
LIMIT 10
